dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: Back home, whenever I fight, it's to protect the people of the tribe. But here, it's more like... never-ending wrestling training.

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: It means I can go all out without worrying about hurting anyone, and I don't get so angry about the injustice of it all. It's so... liberating!

dialogues.speaker: Varesa
dialogues.text: I'm sure that the more I challenge myself here, the stronger I'll become, and the closer I'll get to being like all the fearless heroes I look up to... Definitely gonna come here more often!
